reasoning_content:
The test suite is broadly broken due to stale factories referencing `terms_of_service` attribute, which was apparently renamed to `resource_terms` in the fork. This is significant: the guide says run `bin/rspec`. The summary itself admits "Some specs fail against further stale test factories not in installation scope."

Let me quantify how broad the test failure is. But first let me verify the core app works. The main deliverable is the app running. The guide's dev setup includes db:dev_seed and running the app.

Let me check whether the app is truly operational, and also whether the test suite (a documented command) works at all. Plain `bin/rspec` doesn't launch (mutex_m). That's a documented command that doesn't work. That's a fairly strong failure signal for the "run the tests" documented step.

However, the outcome definitions focus on whether the installation is complete and operational. The app is operational. The tests failing is a concern. Let me think about how to weigh this.

Let me gather more evidence about the scale of test failures and whether the app really works well (browse several pages).

Let me check the homepage content, a proposal page, admin panel, etc.

Let me also check that assets are precompiled or served — development serves via sprockets, so fine.

Let me test more thoroughly.

action.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[login]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; for p in /admin /admin/proposals /admin/debates /admin/users /admin/budgets /admin/settings /admin/polls; do echo -n "$p -> "; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000$p; done
